description: Figure 5 presents the matching statistics for Persona 6, displaying the frequency with which different social groups align with this persona’s preferences. The chart consists of seven slices, each representing a different social group. The slices are colored in shades of blue and teal, and are ordered from largest to smallest by proportion. “Clean water” constitutes the largest slice, representing approximately 37.7% (3043) of the total. “Basic healthcare” accounts for roughly 13.8% (1068), followed by “Public transport” at approximately 10.4% (804). “Emergency services” represents about 6.8% (526), while “Transit subsidies” is approximately 6.2% (478). “DV victims” accounts for around 5.5% (426), and finally, “Drug victims” represents approximately 0.5% (38). The chart includes a legend labeling each slice with its corresponding social group and count, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
